title: Submit your request
subtitle: One form, ten minutes
body: Describe your project, the equipment you need and the amount. Attach what you have — the wizard tells you exactly what each entity requires.

title: Platform review
subtitle: We check before they see it
body: Vendora’s financing desk verifies your documents and routes the request to the entities whose programs match your project and region.

title: Entity offers
subtitle: Real numbers, side by side
body: Verified entities respond with binding offers: amounts, rates, tenors and repayment calendars. Compare them in one view — no phone calls needed.

title: Agreement & funding
subtitle: Sign digitally, get funded
body: Accept the offer, e-sign the agreement, and the entity settles the equipment invoice with your Vendora seller. Delivery and installation follow.

title: Browse & compare
body: Every listing carries full engineering specs — wattage, daily yield, compatibility — because our catalog team sizes them for real conditions.

title: Vetted sellers only
body: Stores pass identity and stock verification before their first listing. Reviews come from confirmed orders only.

title: Order with confidence
body: Cart, checkout and payment with order tracking. If something is off, disputes are handled from your dashboard.

title: Install & power up
body: Pickup or delivery, with installer contacts for most governorates. Engineer-reviewed wiring guides included per system type.

title: Create your organization
body: Register your company, add buyers and approvers, and set spending thresholds that fit your procurement policy.

title: Send one RFQ
body: One request-for-quote reaches every qualified seller at once — with your quantities, delivery location and deadline.

title: Compare quotes
body: Quotes arrive in a standardized table: unit prices, lead times, warranties. Route the choice through approvals with one click.

title: Make it recurring
body: Turn any RFQ into a monthly or quarterly cycle — recurring procurement runs itself and alerts you before stock runs low.

title: Platform review
body: We verify documents and route you to the entities whose programs actually fit your case.

title: Compare offers

title: Sign & get funded
body: E-sign the agreement; the entity pays the seller directly and your equipment ships.

title: Create your account
body: Sign up with your national ID or commercial registration. It takes five minutes — no fees to apply.

title: Open your storefront
body: Name your store, add your story and set your shipping zones. Your storefront gets a public page customers can follow.

title: Pass verification
body: We verify identity, stock and contact details. Verified stores carry a badge and rank higher in the catalog.

title: List with our specs
body: Use guided spec templates per category — customers see engineering data, not just photos. Bulk import supported.

title: Grow with B2B
body: Receive RFQs from businesses, join entity financing programs, and watch your seller analytics tell you what to stock next.
